## Hypothesis

We need to verify that a given strategy candidate passes Stage-1 backtest with walk-forward OOS, real-fills validation on the top 3 J days, and achieves edge_capture >= 771 on the anchor days.

We will run the candidate's logic through the backtesting engine on the full 16-month dataset, compute walk-forward OOS Sharpe, validate real-fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04), and compute edge_capture per OP-16.
